scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:ml && npm run test:env
scripts.test:ml: cross-env PYTHONPATH=ml-service python -m unittest discover -s ml-service/tests
scripts.frontend: cross-env CI=1 npm --prefix frontend run web:clear -- --port 8082
scripts.dev:frontend: cross-env CI=1 npm --prefix frontend run web:clear -- --port 8082
scripts.dev: cross-env ML_SERVICE_API_KEY=dev-only-local-key concurrently -k "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:frontend"
